title: Holonomy Separation and Anyonic Hair in AdS$_3$
summary: Three-dimensional Einstein gravity and Chern-Simons-Higgs matter both admit Chern-Simons descriptions, but their holonomies encode different physics. We prove that charge conjugation reverses the vortex winding $n\to-n$ while leaving the metric and the gravitational connections pointwise unchanged, so every closed gravitational holonomy character, the BTZ charges, the Bañados data and the leading geometric mixed-state hierarchy are exactly even in $n$.
